summary: Community leaderboard of people: rank, avatar, name, subtitle and Intl-formatted points. The top three get gold, silver and bronze badges; highlightId highlights the current user.
whenToUse: Top contributors, speakers or most active members of a community portal.
Gamification: showing users their position among others (highlightId).
whenNotToUse: Rankings of metrics not tied to people (most-read articles, products): use RankingCard, which shows proportional bars and has no avatars.
Data to sort, filter or paginate: use DataTable.
Detailed profile of a single person: use a profile card.

props.name: items
props.description: People already in ranking order (the first is #1, or start).

props.name: title
props.description: Title; also names the list. Without a title pass aria-label or aria-labelledby (they are applied to the list).

props.name: highlightId
props.description: Id of the row to highlight (e.g. the current user), marked with aria-current.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Shows only the first N items.

props.name: start
props.description: Rank of the first item, for subsequent pages.

props.name: variant
props.description: card: bordered surface; plain: no frame.

props.name: footer
props.description: Link to the full leaderboard or a note.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Replaces the rows with a SkeletonList (aria-busy) while keeping the title and footer.

inherits: HTML attributes of <div> (id, style, data-*); aria-label and aria-labelledby go on the <ol> list.

keyboard.action: Moves from one profile link to the next (only for rows with href).

accessibility: Ordered <ol> list named by the title (aria-labelledby) or by aria-label; the rank is also visible text.
Gold, silver and bronze are not the only cue: the rank number is always written.
The avatar is decorative because the name is visible; points are localized text (“12,840 pt”).
The highlightId row has aria-current="true" and is highlighted with a border and background, not just color.
In forced-colors, badges and the current row use Canvas/CanvasText and Highlight.
responsive: Name and subtitle wrap; rank, avatar and points stay fixed: usable at 320px.
plain variant for placing it in a sidebar or an existing Card.
customization: Tokens: --dc-color-feedback-warning-* (gold), --dc-color-surface-strong (silver), --dc-color-data-5 (bronze), --dc-color-action-secondary and --dc-look-fill-tonal for the current row, --dc-gradient-accent for the badge of a user outside the podium.
commonMistakes: Passing unsorted items: the component does not reorder them.
Using Leaderboard for metrics not tied to people: RankingCard is a better fit.
Forgetting to name the list when there is no title.

limits: Podium badges depend on the actual rank (start + index): with start > 3 there are no medals.
No automatic sorting or tie handling.
